description: Net charge, pI, hydropathy and charge density of each LysK construct computed from the UniProt sequence
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

seq="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q6Y7T6.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
assert len(seq)==495

constructs = {
 "LysK full length (1-495)"        : seq[0:495],
 "CHAP only, Horgan C165 (1-165)"  : seq[0:165],
 "CHAP only, C162 (1-162)"         : seq[0:162],
 "Amidase-2 region (182-390)"      : seq[181:390],
 "SH3b alone (404-495)"            : seq[403:495],
 "CHAP-SH3b fusion (1-165+404-495)": seq[0:165]+seq[403:495],
}

pKa={"D":3.65,"E":4.25,"C":8.37,"Y":10.46,"H":6.00,"K":10.53,"R":12.48}
def net_charge(s,pH):
    q=1/(1+10**(pH-8.6)) - 1/(1+10**(3.6-pH))
    for aa in "KRH": q+=s.count(aa)/(1+10**(pH-pKa[aa]))
    for aa in "DECY": q-=s.count(aa)/(1+10**(pKa[aa]-pH))
    return q
def pI(s):
    lo,hi=2.0,13.0
    for _ in range(200):
        mid=(lo+hi)/2
        if net_charge(s,mid)>0: lo=mid
        else: hi=mid
    return (lo+hi)/2
# Kyte-Doolittle
KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,
    'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
MWaa={'A':71.08,'R':156.19,'N':114.10,'D':115.09,'C':103.14,'Q':128.13,'E':129.12,'G':57.05,
      'H':137.14,'I':113.16,'L':113.16,'K':128.17,'M':131.19,'F':147.18,'P':97.12,'S':87.08,
      'T':101.10,'W':186.21,'Y':163.18,'V':99.13}
def mw(s): return sum(MWaa[a] for a in s)+18.02

rows=[]
for name,s in constructs.items():
    m=mw(s)/1000
    rows.append(dict(construct=name,length=len(s),kDa=round(m,1),pI=round(pI(s),2),
        q_pH6_5=round(net_charge(s,6.5),1), q_pH7_5=round(net_charge(s,7.5),1),
        q_per_kDa_pH7_5=round(net_charge(s,7.5)/m,2),
        GRAVY=round(sum(KD[a] for a in s)/len(s),3),
        pct_KR=round(100*sum(s.count(a) for a in "KR")/len(s),1),
        pct_DE=round(100*sum(s.count(a) for a in "DE")/len(s),1),
        n_Cys=s.count("C")))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width",220)
print(df.to_string(index=False))
df.to_csv("lysK_construct_biophysics.csv",index=False)
print("\nwrote lysK_construct_biophysics.csv")

pHs=np.linspace(4,10,200)
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.2,4.5))
ax=axes[0]
for name,s in constructs.items():
    if "Amidase" in name or "C162" in name: continue
    ax.plot(pHs,[net_charge(s,p) for p in pHs],label=name,lw=2)
ax.axhline(0,color="k",lw=.8)
ax.axvline(6.5,color="grey",ls=":",lw=1.3)
ax.axvline(7.5,color="grey",ls="--",lw=1.3)
ax.annotate("Horgan 2009\n50 mM acetate pH 6.5",(6.5,-6),fontsize=7.5,color="dimgray",ha="right")
ax.annotate("Donovan SLB\n150 mM NaCl Tris pH 7.5",(7.6,-11),fontsize=7.5,color="dimgray")
ax.set_xlabel("pH"); ax.set_ylabel("Net charge (Henderson-Hasselbalch, EMBOSS pK)")
ax.set_title("Net charge of LysK constructs versus pH",fontsize=10.5)
ax.legend(fontsize=7.4,loc="upper right"); ax.grid(alpha=.3)

ax=axes[1]
sub=df[~df.construct.str.contains("Amidase")]
cols=["#4C78A8","#E45756","#F58518","#54A24B","#B279A2"]
ax.barh(sub.construct,sub.q_per_kDa_pH7_5,color=cols)
for y,(v) in enumerate(sub.q_per_kDa_pH7_5): ax.text(v+ (0.03 if v>0 else -0.03), y, "%+.2f"%v, va="center", ha="left" if v>0 else "right", fontsize=8)
ax.axvline(0,color="k",lw=.8)
ax.set_xlabel("Net charge per kDa at pH 7.5")
ax.set_title("Charge density: SH3b is the most cationic module",fontsize=10.5)
ax.tick_params(axis="y",labelsize=7.6); ax.grid(axis="x",alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
